decisions.summary: A .drawing.html listed under Entry: is refused at parse, the message naming Drawing:
decisions.why: Enforcement test: a guard that REFUSES, so its reach was measured. _base.py:331 sits inside _about_feature, so it refuses only an About-form modal (the 149 old-form files still listing drawing pages under Entry: today parse untouched), and only on the '.drawing.html' substring of Entry:, which is exactly the set of 'how our maps draw it' pages. Entry: is what sources.research_questions puts on the References tab, so the refusal enforces FR-006 and SC-008 ('no References tab lists a how our maps draw it page') and nothing else; delete that requirement and the refusal has nothing to check. Refusing at import is the established form for every other About-form error (Label:, old prose tags). No reach beyond the request.

decisions.summary: The modal-depiction bundle carries a screenshot crop of the glyph on a pool page (fixed zoom, the page tests' browser); a kind on no pool map bundled without one, saying so
decisions.why: Enforcement test: an INPUT to the requested check, not new behavior - it refuses, blocks and rewrites nothing. FR-014 asks the check to judge the tab 'as drawn' and that 'nothing is claimed that is not drawn'; the drawing pages say what the rules are, the crop is the only thing in the bundle that shows what the glyph actually looks like. Delete the Depiction check and the crop has nothing to serve. The session pitched 'a crop of the glyph' to the GM before his 2026-10-04 reply, which raised no objection. The no-crop fallback does not skip the check (pages and claims rows still go in).

decisions.summary: modal-depiction owed on ANY change to an About-form modal (new to the form, About, Guesses, Entry, Depiction, Drawing) and when a page under Drawing: changed, whether or not the modal has the tab
decisions.why: Round 1's required change, applied as written. FR-014: 'owed by a changed modal or drawing page'. Confirmed in scripts/_modal_owed.py:251-255: the m.depiction.strip() gate is gone; `moved_text or was.depiction != m.depiction` (moved_text is True for was None, so the short-circuit is safe) owes the unit, else a moved Drawing: page does; Modal.depiction covers Depiction and Drawing. test_a_class_new_to_the_about_form_owes_all_four_units now asserts modal-depiction is owed for a modal new to the About form with no tab. modal-research.md line 42 no longer lists drawing pages on References. The trigger is faithful; whether the check it dispatches can see what a conversion dropped is D13-links below.

decisions.summary: modal-depiction's LINKS judged against 'exactly the drawing pages the TAB rests on'; its bundle carries only the pages the modal's Drawing: list names (scripts/_modal_bundle.py:229-233, modal-depiction.md 'drawing/ (each page the modal's Drawing: names)', guideline D5 '(the Drawing: list)')
decisions.why: FR-014 says the links are 'exactly the drawing pages the MODAL rests on' and SC-008 binds 'every rewritten modal whose KIND has a drawing page'; the GM: 'in cases where no such sections exist we would omit the tab' - whether such sections exist is a fact about the kind, not about what the author chose to list. The plan's 'the tab rests on' makes the criterion circular, and the bundle makes it blind: on the very case D13-owed now cites as its purpose ('a conversion that drops its drawing pages and writes no Depiction is still checked'), Drawing: is empty, so drawing/ is empty, claims.md is '(none)' (claims_citing of no pages), and the contract's own rule ('a tab with neither words nor pages should not exist') returns LINKS clean and COVERAGE has only a crop to go on. The round-1 failure - the modal lands with no Depiction tab, its drawing pages silently gone, every check green - is now owed but still undetectable; T20's proof ('it must flag the missing tab') would pass on the farmhouse only because its Drawing: already names 0029.drawing.html. Not physically impossible, measured this round: 231 of the 237 .drawing.html pages sit beside a question stem of the same name (the 6 without are map-sheet and label convention pages), so the kind's candidate drawing pages are derivable from the sibling of every question its Entry: names, plus any .drawing.html the modal's file listed at the merge base (a conversion's old Entry:), plus claims-index rows for the kind's own code units. Not implied by the GM's words, and the literal reading defeats nothing. Required change: D13 (and guideline D5, the agent's LINKS and COVERAGE text, the bundle) must judge LINKS against the drawing pages the MODAL/KIND rests on, and the bundle must carry those candidates beyond Drawing: (at least the sibling drawing page of each Entry question and any drawing page the base revision's file listed), so that a kind with a drawing page and no Depiction tab, or a drawing page missing from Drawing:, is a finding; T20's proof must include a modal whose Drawing: is empty while its kind has a drawing page.
